description: Search what Taseli remembers about this business beyond the business card: older facts, the owner's rules and decisions with their exact words, attempts and how they went, notes waiting for the owner's confirmation. Useful for 'what did I tell you about…', 'did we try…', and for checking what the owner decided earlier.

account.description: An ad account's name, when it is about one account only; omit when it is about the whole business.

include_unconfirmed.description: Also notes that wait for the owner's confirmation. Default false.

query.description: A few English words to look for, e.g. 'shabbat', 'haifa branch', 'brand campaign'. Omit to list the most important rows.

name: get_memory

note.description: A plain note instead of data (nothing connected yet, not available here).

title: Search Taseli's memory
